title: Heads-up push or fold charts
description: The small blind shove frequency and the big blind call frequency for every starting hand at every stack from 1 to 20 big blinds in half steps, with the EV of acting and the equity behind it. Chips only, no ante, solved to an exploitability of at most 0.001 big blind.

data.description: Heads-up push or fold equilibrium, chips only. The small blind moves all in or folds; facing the shove the big blind calls or folds. push[k] and call[k] are the frequencies of class k (grid order, see classes) at each effective stack. EVs are in big blinds, the chip change from the start of the hand before the blinds go in.

game.depths: effective stacks 1 to 20 big blinds in steps of 0.5
game.calledEv: S x (2e - 1) for a stack S and the player's share e of the pot at showdown, ties split

method.hands: the 169 starting-hand classes; the small blind holds class i while the big blind holds class j in proportion to compat[i][j] (pairs of specific hands that share no card, so blockers count)
method.equity: win plus half of tie from equity-matrix.json, small blind against big blind
method.solver: fictitious play (each round, each player takes the best response to the other's average so far), then the hands on the edge are made exactly indifferent with a small linear solve; the profile with the lower exploitability is kept
method.exploitability: what the two players together would gain by each switching to a best response against the published strategies, in big blinds per hand, rounded up to 9 decimals; at most 0.001 at every depth
method.rounding: frequencies to 4 decimals, frequencies of all hands, EVs and equities to 5; every figure is computed from the rounded strategies

fields.pushFrequency: share of all 1,326 hands the small blind shoves
fields.callFrequency: share of all 1,326 hands the big blind calls a shove with
fields.sbValue: small blind's EV per hand dealt
fields.sbPushEv: small blind's EV of shoving each class against the call strategy (folding is sbFoldEv)
fields.bbCallEv: big blind's EV of calling the shove with each class (folding is bbFoldEv); null when no shove can meet the class
fields.sbEquityWhenCalled: small blind's equity with each class against the hands that call; null when none can
fields.bbEquityVsPush: big blind's equity with each class against the hands that shove; null when none can
fields.method: exact when the indifference solve gave the profile, average when the fictitious-play averages did
